test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

CONTROL : NOCTRLO : : MISTAKE : SIMTAEK : : JOURNAL : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) CONTROL : NOCTRLO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6a9072e08d5779442001d702c475637d68c87aed87bb1b9751a09533f6fbbfd.png] 

And,

2) MISTAKE : SIMTAEK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/901d9ef9a8985fc8cdf6d0a0e9e02104ec5c8af432f0fe5340f6445ede78e5fb.png] 

Similarly,

3) JOURNAL : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9b94b7e353b705f0d988b94bb04b7c69cc514a86e80199e6b60289e63939339.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"UOJRNLA".**
